purpose: Open raw-evidence pull requests in grandchallenge/MATHSOLVE for already-created and validated NS-CI intake evidence branches.
authority_source: existing GCL Release Trust GitHub App installation; short-lived per-run token only
allowed_actions: read intake branch raw evidence and receipt
compare intake branch to protected main
open a pull request from an existing validated intake branch to main
post a mechanical intake-controller status comment on the bound dispatch issue
prohibited_actions: create or alter intake evidence branches
claim certification or canonical mathematical effect
use administration, actions-write, checks-write, or workflow-write authority
validation_requirements: branch maps exactly to a protected dispatch identifier
branch diff is exactly one raw result and one receipt for the same comment id
receipt binds the protected dispatch, issue, bootstrap, handoff, and raw SHA-256
receipt is schema-valid, current-for-dispatch, received_unadjudicated, and canonical_claim_effect=false
raw evidence is not already present on protected main
no open intake PR already exists for the branch
